Name: unsupervised_functional_clustering
Title: Do Evo2 Embeddings Spontaneously Cluster by Gene Function? Unsupervised Geometry Analysis
Experiment: Load the cached embeddings from run_0/data/embeddings_evo2_7b.npy and labels from run_0/data/dataset.json. Perform unsupervised analysis: (1) K-means clustering (k=2) on embeddings, compute Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) against true functional labels. Compare ARI to a permutation null (shuffle labels 1000 times). (2) Compute mean within-class cosine distance vs mean between-class cosine distance — ratio < 1.0 indicates functional clustering. (3) Generate a UMAP projection (2D) colored by functional class and save as PNG. (4) Compute silhouette score for the true functional labels in embedding space. Report all metrics with statistical significance vs null. This tests whether Evo2 embeddings organize genes by function WITHOUT any supervised signal.
